english.title: Apply a prescribed stamp not including the approved manufacturers verifying number
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) applied a prescribed stamp under section 15A(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 which did not include the approved verifier's number
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 15A(2) and (3) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

english.notes:
(i) sections 15A(3) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that any equipment in respect of which the offence was committed shall be liable to be forfeited.
(ii) Section 83(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
